fee.label: Fee reminder
fee.hint: For schools and tuition classes. Uses Student Name, Class, Parent Name, Amount and Due Date.
fee.subject: Fee reminder for {student name}
fee.body:
Dear {parent name},

This is a gentle reminder that the fee of {amount|inr} for {student name} (Class {class}) is still pending. Kindly pay it at the school office by {due date}.

If you have already paid, please ignore this letter and share the receipt number with us.

Thank you for your support.

society.label: Society dues notice
society.hint: For housing societies. Uses Flat, Owner Name, Month, Amount and Due Date.
society.subject: Maintenance dues for flat {flat}
society.body:
Dear {owner name},

The maintenance charge of {amount|inr} for {month} for flat {flat} is due on {due date}. Please pay it at the society office or in the usual way.

If you have already paid, kindly ignore this notice.

Thank you for your cooperation.

invite.label: Invitation
invite.hint: For events. Uses Guest Name and any other columns you add.
invite.subject: Invitation to [name of the event]
invite.body:
Dear {guest name},

We would be delighted to have you with us at [name of the event].

Date: [date]
Time: [time]
Venue: [place]

Please let us know if you can come. We look forward to seeing you.

thanks.label: Customer thank-you
thanks.hint: For shops. Uses Customer Name, Order and Amount.
thanks.subject: Thank you for your order
thanks.body:
Dear {customer name},

Thank you for shopping with us. Your order {order} of {amount|inr} is complete. We hope you enjoy it, and we would love to see you again.

If you have any question, please call us on [your phone number].

offer.label: Offer letter
offer.hint: A general format. Uses Name, Role, Start Date and Monthly Pay. Check the wording with your own advisor before you use it.
offer.subject: Offer of the position of {role}
offer.body:
Dear {name},

We are pleased to offer you the position of {role}, starting on {start date}. Your monthly pay will be {monthly pay|inr}.

Please sign and return a copy of this letter to confirm that you accept. We look forward to working with you.
